meanings.definition: Used before a noun to show it is specific
meanings.definition_cn: 用在名词前，表示是特定的那个
meanings.example: The cat with the fluffy tail jumped onto my bed.
meanings.example_cn: 那只长着蓬松尾巴的猫跳上了我的床。

meanings.example: That was the best birthday party I've ever had.
meanings.example_cn: 那是我参加过的最棒的生日派对。

meanings.example: I want to be a kind person when I grow up.
meanings.example_cn: 我长大后想成为一个善良的人。

meanings.example: I want to be a kind person when I grow up.
meanings.example_cn: 我长大后想成为一个善良的人。

meanings.definition: To link a subject to a description
meanings.example: The soup is hot and smells delicious.
meanings.example_cn: 这汤很烫，闻起来很香。

meanings.example: Lily likes to draw and paint colorful pictures.
meanings.example_cn: 莉莉喜欢画五颜六色的图画。

meanings.example: The wheels of my new bike are bright red.
meanings.example_cn: 我的新自行车的轮子是鲜红色的。

meanings.example: This necklace is made of shiny gold.
meanings.example_cn: 这条项链是用闪亮的金子做的。

meanings.example: We walked to the playground after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我们走向操场。

meanings.example: I love to read exciting adventure stories.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢读刺激的冒险故事。

meanings.example: The puppy is sleeping in the soft basket.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗正在柔软的篮子里睡觉。

meanings.example: We go swimming in the summer when it's hot.
meanings.example_cn: 夏天天气热的时候，我们去游泳。

meanings.definition: one of a kind, not specific
meanings.example: I found a tiny ladybug crawling on my shoe.
meanings.example_cn: 我发现一只小瓢虫在我的鞋子上爬。

meanings.definition: present form of be for one thing
meanings.definition_cn: be的第三人称单数现在时
meanings.example: My favorite toy is a bright red car.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的玩具是一辆鲜红色的汽车。

meanings.example: That is the drawing I made for art class.
meanings.example_cn: 那是我为美术课画的画。

meanings.example: I want the book that has a dragon on the cover.
meanings.example_cn: 我想要那本封面上有龙的书。

meanings.example: I didn't know that you could play the piano.
meanings.example_cn: 我不知道你会弹钢琴。

meanings.definition: Refers to a thing or animal
meanings.example: I found a little turtle, and it was hiding under a leaf.
meanings.example_cn: 我发现了一只小乌龟，它正躲在一片叶子下面。

meanings.example: I finished my project, and it was a lot of work.
meanings.example_cn: 我完成了我的项目，它花了好多功夫。

meanings.example: I made a card for my friend's birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我为朋友的生日做了一张卡片。

meanings.example: We waited for two hours to see the parade.
meanings.example_cn: 我们等了两个小时看游行。

meanings.example: There are three apples on the kitchen table.
meanings.example_cn: 厨房的桌子上有三个苹果。

meanings.example: We had a lesson on dinosaurs in science class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在科学课上学习了关于恐龙的内容。

meanings.example: I went to the park with my cousin yesterday.
meanings.example_cn: 我昨天和表哥一起去公园了。

meanings.example: She cut the paper with a pair of sharp scissors.
meanings.example_cn: 她用一把锋利的剪刀剪纸。

meanings.example: He dressed up as a superhero for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 他在派对上打扮成超级英雄。

meanings.example: Try to write as neatly as you can.
meanings.example_cn: 尽量写得和你能写的一样整齐。

meanings.example: I really enjoy reading adventure stories at night.
meanings.example_cn: 我真的很喜欢在晚上读冒险故事。

meanings.example: Max forgot his blue backpack at school yesterday.
meanings.example_cn: 马克斯昨天把他的蓝色背包忘在学校了。

meanings.definition: more than one person or thing
meanings.example: They always laugh at my silly jokes.
meanings.example_cn: 他们总是被我滑稽的笑话逗笑。

meanings.example: Meet me at the library after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后在图书馆见我。

meanings.example: She sat at the front of the classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 她坐在教室的前面。

meanings.example: This cookie tastes amazing with chocolate chips.
meanings.example_cn: 这块巧克力曲奇吃起来棒极了。

meanings.example: Choose this pencil if you want a blue one.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你想要蓝色的铅笔，就选这一支。

meanings.example: I have a pet hamster named Nibbles.
meanings.example_cn: 我有一只叫尼布尔斯的宠物仓鼠。

meanings.example: Let's have some lemonade with our snack.
meanings.example_cn: 我们吃点心时喝点柠檬水吧。

meanings.example: We walked from our house to the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我们从家里走到操场。

meanings.example: My grandma is from a small town in Italy.
meanings.example_cn: 我的奶奶来自意大利的一个小镇。

meanings.example: Would you like apple juice or orange juice?
meanings.example_cn: 你想要苹果汁还是橙汁？

meanings.example: The cat sat quietly by the window.
meanings.example_cn: 猫安静地坐在窗边。

meanings.example: This picture was painted by my sister.
meanings.example_cn: 这幅画是我姐姐画的。

meanings.example: Can you spell the word “elephant” correctly?
meanings.example_cn: 你能正确拼出“elephant”这个单词吗？

meanings.example: I wanted to play outside, but it started to rain.
meanings.example_cn: 我想出去玩，但是开始下雨了。

meanings.example: My shoes are not under the bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我的鞋子不在床底下。

meanings.example: What time does the movie start tonight?
meanings.example_cn: 电影今晚几点开始？

meanings.example: I didn't hear what you said because it was noisy.
meanings.example_cn: 因为太吵了，我没听清你说的话。

meanings.example: All the cookies disappeared during the party.
meanings.example_cn: 派对上所有的饼干都不见了。

meanings.example: He was all wet after running through the sprinkler.
meanings.example_cn: 他从喷水器下面跑过，全身都湿了。

meanings.example: We made chocolate chip cookies together last night.
meanings.example_cn: 我们昨晚一起做了巧克力曲奇饼干。

meanings.example: When will you come over to play?
meanings.example_cn: 你什么时候过来玩？

meanings.example: Call me when you get home from school.
meanings.example_cn: 你放学到家后给我打电话。

meanings.example: Don’t forget your warm jacket before going out.
meanings.example_cn: 出门前别忘了带上你暖和的外套。

meanings.example: I can ride my bike with no training wheels.
meanings.example_cn: 我可以不用辅助轮骑自行车了。

meanings.example: You can have an extra cookie after dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭后你可以再吃一块饼干。

meanings.example: There are ducks swimming over there in the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 那边的池塘里有鸭子在游泳。

meanings.definition_cn: 和 is / are 一起使用
meanings.example: There is a new student in our class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班来了一位新同学。

meanings.definition: one of a kind, before a vowel sound
meanings.example: I saw an amazing rainbow after the rain stopped.
meanings.example_cn: 雨停后，我看见了一道美丽的彩虹。

meanings.example: Each student brought a different book to class.
meanings.example_cn: 每个学生都带了一本不同的书来班上。

meanings.example: Which color do you like best, blue or green?
meanings.example_cn: 蓝色和绿色，你最喜欢哪一种？

meanings.example: Pick the book which has the shiny cover.
meanings.example_cn: 选那本封面闪闪发亮的书。

meanings.example: She dances gracefully during ballet class.
meanings.example_cn: 她在芭蕾舞课上优雅地跳舞。

meanings.example: We do our chores every Saturday morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每个星期六早上做家务。

meanings.example: Do you want to join us for the game?
meanings.example_cn: 你想和我们一起玩游戏吗？

meanings.example: Their new puppy is small and fluffy.
meanings.example_cn: 他们的新小狗又小又毛茸茸的。

meanings.example: If you finish your homework, we can play outside.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你做完作业，我们就可以去外面玩。

meanings.example: I don't know if it will rain tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我不知道明天会不会下雨。

meanings.example: Mom will pick us up after school today.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈今天会放学后来接我们。

meanings.example: I will help you carry your backpack if you need.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你需要，我愿意帮你背书包。

meanings.example: The balloon floated up into the blue sky.
meanings.example_cn: 气球飘上了蓝天。

meanings.example: The music got louder as we turned up the volume.
meanings.example_cn: 我们调大音量，音乐变得更响了。

meanings.example: I have one red shoe and the other is blue.
meanings.example_cn: 我有一只红色的鞋，另外一只是蓝色的。

meanings.example: You take one cookie, and I'll have the other.
meanings.example_cn: 你拿一块饼干，我拿另一块。

meanings.example: The dog ran out of the house to chase the squirrel.
meanings.example_cn: 狗跑出房子去追松鼠。

meanings.example: Dad is out right now but will be back soon.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸现在不在家，但很快就会回来。

meanings.example: I was at the park then, so I didn't hear the phone.
meanings.example_cn: 那时我在公园，所以没听到电话。

meanings.example: We ate dinner, then watched our favorite show together.
meanings.example_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，然后一起看最喜欢的节目。

meanings.definition: more than one person or thing, object form
meanings.definition_cn: 不止一个人或事物，宾格
meanings.example: I shared my crayons with them during art class.
meanings.example_cn: 我在美术课上和他们分享了我的蜡笔。

meanings.example: I was so excited for my birthday party!
meanings.example_cn: 我对生日派对感到非常兴奋！

meanings.example: It started to rain, so we played inside instead.
meanings.example_cn: 开始下雨了，所以我们在屋里玩。

meanings.example: Would you like some juice with your snack?
meanings.example_cn: 你吃点心时要喝点果汁吗？

meanings.example: Some of my friends are coming over this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我这周末有几个朋友会过来。

meanings.example: I saw her at the library reading a big book.
meanings.example_cn: 我在图书馆看见她正在读一本大书。

meanings.example: Her backpack is decorated with bright stickers.
meanings.example_cn: 她的书包上贴着鲜艳的贴纸。

meanings.example: Would you please pass me the salt?
meanings.example_cn: 请你把盐递给我好吗？

meanings.example: If I had wings, I would fly around the world.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我有翅膀，我会飞遍全世界。

meanings.example: Let's make a giant sandcastle at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在海滩上做一个巨大的沙堡吧。

meanings.example: Loud noises make my puppy bark a lot.
meanings.example_cn: 很大的声音会让我的小狗叫个不停。

meanings.example: Give him the blue cup because it’s his favorite.
meanings.example_cn: 把那个蓝色的杯子给他，因为那是他最喜欢的。

meanings.example: The frog jumped into the cool, clear pond.
meanings.example_cn: 青蛙跳进了清凉清澈的池塘里。

meanings.example: Time goes by quickly when you're having fun.
meanings.example_cn: 开心的时候，时间过得很快。

meanings.example: The first time I rode a bike, I felt so proud.
meanings.example_cn: 我第一次骑自行车时，感到非常自豪。

meanings.definition: present form of have for one person or thing
meanings.example: She has a beautiful new backpack for school.
meanings.example_cn: 她有一个漂亮的新书包。

meanings.example: Look at the rainbow outside the window!
meanings.example_cn: 看窗外的那道彩虹！

meanings.example: You look happy today with your big smile.
meanings.example_cn: 你今天笑得这么开心，看起来很高兴。

meanings.example: Please write your name neatly on the paper.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的名字整齐地写在纸上。

meanings.example: We will go to the museum after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们要去博物馆。

meanings.example: It's getting late, so we should go now.
meanings.example_cn: 天色晚了，我们该走了。

meanings.example: Can you see the tiny ladybug on the leaf?
meanings.example_cn: 你能看见叶子上的小瓢虫吗？

meanings.example: Now I see what you meant about the puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 现在我明白你说的那个谜题是什么意思了。

meanings.definition: a word or sign for a count
meanings.example: What number comes after twenty-nine?
meanings.example_cn: 二十九后面的数字是什么？

meanings.example: There is a shortcut way to the playground through the park.
meanings.example_cn: 穿过公园有一条去操场的近路。

meanings.example: The best way to solve the puzzle is to start with the corners.
meanings.example_cn: 解这道拼图的最好方法是从角落开始。

meanings.definition_cn: can 的过去式，表示过去能够
meanings.example: When I was younger, I could climb that tree easily.
meanings.example_cn: 我小时候能轻松地爬上那棵树。

meanings.example: Could you help me find my missing shoe?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我找到我丢失的鞋子吗？

meanings.example: My little brother loves dinosaurs.
meanings.example_cn: 我的小弟弟非常喜欢恐龙。

meanings.example: I was the first to finish the race at school.
meanings.example_cn: 我在学校比赛里第一个冲过终点。

meanings.example: First, we wash our hands, then we eat dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 首先，我们洗手，然后吃晚饭。

meanings.example: Don't forget to drink water after playing outside.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完后，别忘了喝水。

meanings.example: We sailed across the blue water to the island.
meanings.example_cn: 我们驶过蓝色的大海，来到小岛。

meanings.definition: To speak to on the phone
meanings.example: I will call Grandma to tell her about my day.
meanings.example_cn: 我会给奶奶打电话，告诉她我今天做了什么。

meanings.example: We decided to call our new kitten Whiskers.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定给我们的新小猫取名叫胡须。

meanings.example: Who wants to help me bake cookies?
meanings.example_cn: 谁想帮我烤饼干？

meanings.example: She's the girl who won the spelling contest.
meanings.example_cn: 她就是那个赢得拼字比赛的女孩。

meanings.definition: belonging to a thing or animal
meanings.example: The turtle hid inside its hard shell.
meanings.example_cn: 乌龟躲进了它坚硬的壳里。

meanings.example: We can start the movie now that everyone is here.
meanings.example_cn: 现在大家都到了，我们可以开始看电影了。

meanings.example: Come here now or you'll miss the bus!
meanings.example_cn: 马上过来，不然你就赶不上公交车了！

meanings.example: I can't wait to find hidden eggs during the hunt.
meanings.example_cn: 我迫不及待想在寻宝游戏里找到藏起来的蛋。

meanings.example: I find this math problem really interesting.
meanings.example_cn: 我觉得这道数学题真的很有趣。

meanings.example: He has a long jump rope that reaches across the room.
meanings.example_cn: 他有一根长长的跳绳，能跨过整个房间。

meanings.example: The movie was so long that I almost fell asleep.
meanings.example_cn: 这部电影太长了，我差点睡着。

meanings.example: The ball rolled down the hill and into the grass.
meanings.example_cn: 球滚下山坡，进了草丛里。

meanings.example: The basement is down the stairs and on the left.
meanings.example_cn: 地下室在楼梯下面，靠左边。

meanings.example: We spent the whole day playing at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我们一整天都在海滩上玩。

meanings.example: There are seven days in a week.
meanings.example_cn: 一个星期有七天。

meanings.example: I hope to get a new book for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我希望生日时能得到一本新书。

meanings.example: If you stay outside too long, you'll get cold.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你在外面待太久，会变冷的。

meanings.example: Please come to the kitchen for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 请到厨房来吃晚饭。

meanings.example: The train will come at exactly five o'clock.
meanings.example_cn: 火车会在五点准时到达。

meanings.example: You may have another cookie if you finish your dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你吃完饭，可以再吃一块饼干。

meanings.example: It may rain tomorrow, so bring your umbrella.
meanings.example_cn: 明天可能会下雨，所以带上雨伞。

meanings.example: I lost one part of my favorite puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 我丢失了我最喜欢的拼图中的一块。

meanings.example: My friend got the main part in the school play.
meanings.example_cn: 我的朋友在学校话剧中得到了主角。

meanings.example: The airplane flew over the city buildings.
meanings.example_cn: 飞机飞过城市的高楼。

meanings.example: The game is over, and everyone played well.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束了，每个人都表现得很好。

meanings.example: There are over fifty books in our classroom library.
meanings.example_cn: 我们教室图书馆里有五十多本书。

meanings.example: I got a new backpack for the first day of school.
meanings.example_cn: 开学第一天，我得到了一个新书包。

meanings.example: Try this new bread; it's still warm from the oven.
meanings.example_cn: 尝尝这个新烤的面包，还热乎着呢。

meanings.example: The sound of rain helps me fall asleep at night.
meanings.example_cn: 夜晚的雨声帮助我入睡。

meanings.example: You sound excited about your field trip tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 听起来你对明天的郊游很兴奋。

meanings.example: Please take your lunchbox to school every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 请每天早上把你的饭盒带到学校。

meanings.example: It will take an hour to finish this puzzle.
meanings.example_cn: 完成这道拼图需要一个小时。

meanings.example: There's only one cookie left on the plate.
meanings.example_cn: 盘子里只剩下一块饼干了。

meanings.example: She's the only person who knows the secret.
meanings.example_cn: 她是唯一知道秘密的人。

meanings.example: My homework is the hardest work I do at home.
meanings.example_cn: 我的家庭作业是我在家里做的最难的任务。

meanings.example: Dad will work late at the office tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸今晚会在办公室工作到很晚。

meanings.example: I know how to tie my shoes by myself.
meanings.example_cn: 我知道怎么自己系鞋带。

meanings.example: Do you know this fun game we're playing?
meanings.example_cn: 你知道我们正在玩的这个有趣游戏吗？

meanings.example: This playground is my favorite place to have fun.
meanings.example_cn: 这个游乐场是我最喜欢玩的地方。

meanings.example: I got first place in the spelling bee last year.
meanings.example_cn: 去年我在拼字比赛中得了第一名。

meanings.example: We went camping last year during the summer.
meanings.example_cn: 去年夏天我们去露营了。

meanings.definition: The time the earth takes around the sun
meanings.definition_cn: 地球绕太阳一圈的时间
meanings.example: A year on Earth is 365 days long.
meanings.example_cn: 地球上的一年有365天。

meanings.example: Some plants can live for over a hundred years.
meanings.example_cn: 有些植物可以活一百多年。

meanings.example: I live in a house with my family and my dog.
meanings.example_cn: 我和我的家人、小狗住在一栋房子里。

meanings.example: Can you pass me the green marker?
meanings.example_cn: 你能把绿色的马克笔递给我吗？

meanings.example: We walked back to the house after the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束后，我们走回房子里。

meanings.example: The dog has a white spot on its back.
meanings.example_cn: 这只狗的背上有一块白斑。

meanings.example: Please give this note to your teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 请把这张纸条递给你的老师。

meanings.example: The library will give us new books every month.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆每个月都会给我们新书。

meanings.example: That movie was very funny and made me laugh a lot.
meanings.example_cn: 那部电影非常搞笑，让我笑了好久。

meanings.example: We ate dessert after dinner was finished.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭后我们才吃甜点。

meanings.example: The students lined up after their teacher in the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 学生们在走廊里跟在老师后面排队。

meanings.example: That shiny thing on the table is my new pencil case.
meanings.example_cn: 桌上那个闪亮的东西是我的新铅笔盒。

meanings.example: The best thing about today was our class party.
meanings.example_cn: 今天最棒的事是我们班的派对。

meanings.example: Our class made a colorful mural for the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班为走廊制作了一幅五颜六色的壁画。

meanings.example: I have just one piece of candy left.
meanings.example_cn: 我只剩下一颗糖了。

meanings.example: I just finished my homework a minute ago.
meanings.example_cn: 我刚在一分钟前做完作业。

meanings.example: This puzzle piece fits just right in the corner.
meanings.example_cn: 这块拼图正好能放进角落里。

meanings.definition: The word that calls someone or something
meanings.definition_cn: 名字；称呼某人或某物的词
meanings.example: My dog’s name is Max, and he loves to play fetch.
meanings.example_cn: 我的狗叫马克斯，它喜欢玩接球游戏。

meanings.example: We decided to name our new kitten Whiskers.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定给新小猫起名叫胡须。

meanings.example: She got a good grade on her spelling test.

meanings.example: When I was small, I loved to build sandcastles.

meanings.example_cn: 那个大气球高高地飘到了树上方。

meanings.example: There’s a big tree in our backyard with a swing.
meanings.example_cn: 我们家后院有一棵大树，上面挂着秋千。

meanings.example: Winning the spelling bee was a big moment for me.
meanings.example_cn: 赢得拼字比赛对我来说是重要的时刻。

meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢在睡前读冒险书。

meanings.example_cn: 长途航行后，我们看到一艘船正靠近陆地。

meanings.example_cn: 明年夏天我们要搬到新房子去。

meanings.example_cn: 我要自己尝试解开这个谜题。

meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的水果种类是西瓜。

meanings.example: It’s kind to share your toys with others.

meanings.example_cn: 她左手腕上戴了一只手镯。

meanings.example_cn: 我的墙上挂着一幅城堡的画。

meanings.example: I have a picture of the story in my imagination.
meanings.example_cn: 我的脑海里有一幅这个故事的画面。

meanings.example: Can we visit the zoo again next weekend?

meanings.example: The leaves change color in the fall.

meanings.example_cn: 我做了一个非常清晰的梦，梦见自己像鸟儿一样飞翔。

meanings.definition_cn: 华夫饼；蛋奶烘饼；含糊其辞
meanings.example: We had waffles with strawberries for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我们早餐吃了草莓华夫饼。

meanings.definition_cn: 含糊其辞；胡扯；闲聊；绕圈子
meanings.example: Stop waffling and give a straight answer.
meanings.example_cn: 别绕圈子，直接回答。

meanings.example: We learned about an important war in history class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在历史课上学习了一场重要的战争。

meanings.example: The two nations warred for years.
meanings.example_cn: 两国交战多年。

meanings.definition_cn: 警告；告诫；提醒；预告；通知
meanings.example: The lifeguard used a whistle to warn swimmers about deep water.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员用哨子提醒游泳的人水深危险。

meanings.definition_cn: 是；在；存在（be的单数过去式）
meanings.example: It was sunny and bright all day long.
meanings.example_cn: 一整天都阳光明媚。

meanings.definition_cn: 瀑布；瀑布似的东西；瀑布般倾泻
meanings.example: We saw a beautiful waterfall on our hike.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在徒步旅行时看到了一道美丽的瀑布。

meanings.example: Cold watermelon is the best snack on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 炎热的夏天，冰凉的西瓜是最棒的零食。

meanings.definition_cn: 弱的；虚弱的；薄弱的；淡的；不熟练的
meanings.example: I felt weak after being sick, but soon got stronger.
meanings.example_cn: 生病后我感觉很虚弱，但很快就恢复了力气。

meanings.definition_cn: 天气；气象；处境；恶劣天气
meanings.example: The weather forecast says it will be rainy tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

meanings.definition: to endure; to expose to weather
meanings.example: The house weathered the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 房子经受住了风暴。

meanings.definition: the fourth day of the week
meanings.example: Wednesday is the middle of the school week.
meanings.example_cn: 星期三是一周上学的中间日子。

meanings.definition_cn: 欢迎；迎接；乐于接受；赞成
meanings.example: We made a big sign to welcome our new neighbor.
meanings.example_cn: 我们做了一个大大的牌子来欢迎新邻居。

meanings.example: They gave us a warm welcome.
meanings.example_cn: 他们热情欢迎我们。

meanings.definition_cn: 受欢迎的；令人愉快的；可随便使用的；不必感谢的
meanings.example: You are always welcome.
meanings.example_cn: 随时欢迎你。

meanings.definition_cn: 湿的；下雨的；多雨的；脆弱的；软弱的
meanings.example: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 我踩进水坑时袜子湿掉了。

meanings.example: He wets the towel before wiping.
meanings.example_cn: 他擦之前把毛巾弄湿。

meanings.definition: anything at all; no matter what
meanings.definition_cn: 无论什么；任何……的事物；诸如此类
meanings.example: You can draw whatever you like in your art book.
meanings.example_cn: 你可以在你的画册里画任何你喜欢的东西。

meanings.definition_cn: 无论什么样的；任何的；究竟
meanings.example: Whatever reason he gives, I will go.
meanings.example_cn: 无论他什么理由，我都要去。

meanings.definition_cn: 无论何时；每当；随时；究竟何时
meanings.example: You can call me whenever you need help.
meanings.example_cn: 你无论何时需要帮助，都可以给我打电话。

meanings.definition_cn: 无论哪里；在任何地方；究竟在哪里
meanings.example: I take my favorite book wherever I go.
meanings.example_cn: 我无论去哪里都会带上我最喜欢的书。

meanings.example: I’m not sure whether to wear boots or sneakers today.
meanings.example_cn: 我不确定今天该穿靴子还是运动鞋。

meanings.definition_cn: 谁（who的宾格）；那个人；那些人
meanings.example: To whom should I give this letter?
meanings.example_cn: 这封信我应该交给谁呢？

meanings.definition_cn: 谁的；那（些）人的；它的；那一个的
meanings.example: Whose backpack is on the playground bench?
meanings.example_cn: 操场长椅上的背包是谁的？

meanings.definition_cn: 获胜者；优胜者；成功者；得奖者
meanings.example: The winner of the spelling bee got a gold medal.
meanings.example_cn: 拼字比赛的获胜者获得了一枚金牌。

meanings.definition_cn: 希望；想要；祝愿；但愿；请求
meanings.example: I made a wish when I blew out my birthday candles.
meanings.example_cn: 我吹灭生日蜡烛时许了一个愿。

meanings.definition_cn: 愿望；希望；祝愿；请求；心愿
meanings.example: She gots her wish.
meanings.example_cn: 她如愿以偿。

meanings.definition_cn: 在……之内；在……里面；不超过；在……范围内
meanings.example: Please finish your homework within an hour.
meanings.example_cn: 请在一小时内完成作业。

meanings.definition_cn: 在内部；在里面；在内心；户内
meanings.example: The house was clean within.
meanings.example_cn: 房子里面很干净。

meanings.definition_cn: 成年女子；妇女；女仆；爱人；女性
meanings.example: The woman at the bakery gave us free samples.
meanings.example_cn: 面包店的那位女士给了我们一些免费试吃。

meanings.definition_cn: 蠕虫；寄生虫；螺纹；可鄙的人；蜗杆
meanings.example: We found a wiggly worm in the garden soil.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在花园的泥土里发现了一条扭来扭去的蚯蚓。

meanings.definition_cn: 蠕行；潜行；套出；使在……中蠕动
meanings.example: He wormed his way through the crowd.
meanings.example_cn: 他在人群中挤过去。

meanings.definition_cn: 担心的；焦虑的；烦恼的；为难的
meanings.example: I was worried when my cat didn’t come home.
meanings.example_cn: 我的猫没回家时我很担心。

meanings.example: The nurse cleaned my wound and put on a bandage.
meanings.example_cn: 护士清理了我的伤口，然后贴上了绷带。

meanings.definition_cn: 使受伤；伤害；使受伤；使创伤
meanings.example: He was wounded in the war.
meanings.example_cn: 他在战争中受伤。

meanings.example: Please don’t yell in the hallway.
meanings.example_cn: 请不要在走廊里大喊大叫。

meanings.example: He gaves a yell of pain.
meanings.example_cn: 他疼得大叫。

meanings.definition_cn: 还；尚；仍然；已经；还（否定句）
meanings.example: The mail hasn’t arrived yet this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 今天早上邮件还没有送到。

meanings.example: The work is hard, yet I enjoy it.
meanings.example_cn: 工作虽难，但我喜欢。

meanings.example: You did a fantastic job on your project!
meanings.example_cn: 你的项目完成得太棒了！

meanings.definition_cn: 你自己；您自己；你本人；你亲自
meanings.example: Make sure you take care of yourself if you feel sick.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你感觉不舒服，一定要好好照顾自己。

meanings.definition: a large reptile with long jaws, like a crocodile
meanings.example: We watched an alligator sunbathe at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在动物园看到一只鳄鱼在晒太阳。

meanings.definition: a small animal with many legs
meanings.example: A centipede crawled quickly under the rock.
meanings.example_cn: 一只蜈蚣快速地爬到石头下面。

meanings.definition: the fastest land animal, a spotted big cat
meanings.example: The cheetah is the fastest animal in the world.
meanings.example_cn: 猎豹是世界上跑得最快的动物。

meanings.definition: a sea animal with a hard shell and pincers
meanings.example: The crab scuttled sideways along the sandy shore.
meanings.example_cn: 螃蟹横着身子在沙滩上快步移动。

meanings.definition: a flying insect that glows in the dark
meanings.example: I caught a firefly and watched it glow in the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 我捉了一只萤火虫，看着它在黑暗中发光。

meanings.definition: a green insect that jumps and makes sound
meanings.example: The grasshopper leaped into the tall grass.
meanings.example_cn: 蚱蜢跳进了高高的草丛里。

meanings.definition: a wild animal that laughs and scavenges
meanings.example: The hyena laughed as it played with its friends.
meanings.example_cn: 鬣狗和朋友们一起玩耍，发出咯咯的笑声。

meanings.definition: a small red beetle with black spots
meanings.example: A tiny ladybug landed on my finger.
meanings.example_cn: 一只小瓢虫落在了我的手指上。

meanings.example: We saw pink shrimp swimming in the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在水族馆里看到粉红色的虾在游来游去。

meanings.definition: physical harm or damage to the body
meanings.example: I got a small injury on my knee while playing soccer.
meanings.example_cn: 我踢足球时膝盖受了一点小伤。
